plain.li: My {OLD} glowed this morning, bright enough to make me shut my eyes, and when I opened them it had become {NEW}, looking back at me as if nothing had happened.
It happened in the middle of the afternoon, with no warning. One moment it was my {OLD}, the next it had evolved into {NEW}, a head taller and very proud of it.
All that training, and today it came good. The {OLD} I caught has evolved into {NEW}. I keep looking at it.
[named] {PET_nameDef} evolved today. Same eyes. Everything else is new, and it's still getting used to its legs.
[named] {PET_nameDef} has evolved into {NEW}. I had to sit down afterwards.
[shiny] It kept its strange colours through the change, and shines brighter than ever. People came from the far end of the colony to see.
[night] It evolved in the night, by the fire. Lit up the whole room. Half the colony thought it was a raid.
[child] My {OLD} turned into {NEW}! It was all glowy and then it was bigger! It still likes me.

warm.li: My {OLD} has evolved into {NEW}. I told it I was proud of it, and I think it understood.
[named] {PET_nameDef} evolved, and the first thing it did was come and find me. I'll remember that.

cheerful.li: My very own {NEW}! I danced. Nobody saw. Probably.

gloomy.li: My {OLD} is gone, and the {NEW} is in its place. It's the same one, I know it is. I'll miss the small one anyway.

cold.li: {OLD} to {NEW} today. A stronger animal. That was the point of the training.

plain.li: Look at you. Just look at you.
You did it. You actually did it.
You're bigger than me now, aren't you?
[named] {PET_nameDef}! Is that still you in there?
[shiny] Still shining. Good.

warm.li: I'm so proud of you. So proud.

gloomy.li: You'll still let me carry you sometimes, won't you?

plain.li: Was that it? Did it just evolve?
Evolved into {NEW}! Well done, the both of you.
All that training paid off, then.
[named] {PET_nameDef} looks half a head taller already.
[shiny] It kept its colours. That's rare, that is.

warm.li: You've done well with it. Anyone can see it.

cheerful.li: That was amazing! Do it again!

gloomy.li: Don't let it get too big for the barracks.

plain.li: [level:25] Level {LEVEL} today. It's past the clumsy stage now. You can see it thinking in a fight.
[level:25,named] {PET_nameDef} reached level {LEVEL}. I marked it on the wall by my bed.
[level:50] Level {LEVEL}. Half the way to what the old trainers called mastery, and it got there here, of all places.
[level:50,named] {PET_nameDef} is level {LEVEL} today. The others stop to watch when we train now.
[level:75] Level {LEVEL}. I don't think I'm teaching it anything any more. I think it's teaching me.
[level:100] Level {LEVEL}. As far as any of them go. I sat with it a long time tonight and didn't say much.
[level:100,named] {PET_nameDef} reached level {LEVEL} today. There's nothing left to train for, and I don't mind at all.

warm.li: Another milestone for us both. Level {LEVEL}. Every one of them was earned together.

cheerful.li: Level {LEVEL}! We had a little party. Berries for everyone with four legs.

gloomy.li: Level {LEVEL}. It's grown so much stronger than I have.

cold.li: Level {LEVEL} reached. Its record is in the ledger.

plain.li: Something has changed between my Pokémon and me. It doesn't go back in its ball unless I ask it twice, and it sleeps at my door.
It came to find me today when I was nowhere near the pens, just to be near me. The others say that's a bond. I think they're right.
[named] {PET_nameDef} won't leave my side any more. I didn't train it to. It decided.
[child] My Pokémon is my best friend now. Properly. It said so. Not in words.

warm.li: [named] {PET_nameDef} and I belong to each other now. I didn't know it could feel like this.

blunt.li: It follows me everywhere now. Fine by me.

cheerful.li: It loves me! It actually loves me! I'm not sharing it with anybody.

gloomy.li: It trusts me completely now. I hope I'm worth it.

cold.li: The bond has formed. It'll fight harder for me now, and I for it.

plain.li: My Pokémon went down in the fighting today. I couldn't get to it until it was over. It's resting now, and I'm sitting with it.
It fainted in front of me and I couldn't do a thing. It's awake again, and it ate. I haven't eaten.
[named] {PET_nameDef} took a blow meant for one of us and went down. The doctor says it'll be fine. I'm not leaving until it is.
[night] Kept watch by my Pokémon all night after the fight. It woke once, saw me, and went back to sleep.

warm.li: It fought for us and it fell. When it woke, I told it how brave it had been.

blunt.li: It went down. It got up. That's what matters.

cheerful.li: It's awake! Grumpy and hungry, but awake. Best sound I've heard all week.

gloomy.li: It fainted today. Next time it might not get up. I keep thinking about next time.

cold.li: My Pokémon fainted in the fight. It needs rest and more training before the next one.

plain.li: The {SPECIES} is ours. Two days of following it, and it went into the ball on the last throw I had.
I caught the {SPECIES}. People will be telling this story long after I'm gone, and they'll get it wrong.
[winter] Caught the {SPECIES} in the snow, both of us half frozen. It's warming up by the fire now and looking at me as if I'm the strange one.

warm.li: The {SPECIES} is ours now, and I promised it a good life. I mean to keep that promise.

blunt.li: Got the {SPECIES}. Told you I would.

cheerful.li: The {SPECIES}! I caught the {SPECIES}! I'm going to write it again. The {SPECIES}!

gloomy.li: Caught the {SPECIES}. It was so free out there. I hope it forgives me.

cold.li: The {SPECIES} is caught. A rare one, and worth the trouble.

plain.li: A wild one watched me work all afternoon. I think it was trying to learn how. I hope it learns faster than the new hands.
Every time I looked up, there it was, a little closer. Wild Pokémon are curious things.
[child] A wild Pokémon was watching me! I waved and it did a funny thing with its head.

warm.li: A wild one kept me company today. It never came close, but it never left.

blunt.li: Got watched by a wild one. Didn't mind.

cheerful.li: I had an audience today! A very small, very serious audience.

gloomy.li: A wild one watched me all day. I couldn't tell whether it was curious or waiting.

cold.li: A wild Pokémon observed the work today. It showed no fear of people. Worth remembering.

plain.li: I saw one in the wrong colours today. A shining one. I've heard the stories all my life, and today I saw it.
It caught the light like a coin. Nobody believed me until they went to look themselves.

warm.li: Saw a shining one today. I'll never forget it, and I don't want to.

blunt.li: Saw a shiny. Couldn't catch it. Still saw it.

cheerful.li: A shiny! A real one! I'll be telling this one forever!

gloomy.li: A shining one, and I had nothing to throw. Of course I didn't.

cold.li: A shiny was seen near the colony today. Rare enough to note.

plain.li: A rare one crossed our land today, unhurried, as if it owned it. Maybe it does.
I watched a rare one go by at the edge of the land. My hands are still shaking.

warm.li: A rare one came through today. It looked at me once, and I felt honoured.

blunt.li: Rare one went by. Gone now.

cheerful.li: I saw a rare one! Close enough to see its eyes!

gloomy.li: A rare one passed by today. Things like that don't stay anywhere long.

cold.li: A rare species was seen today. Its range must reach this far.

plain.li: A wild Pokémon took a berry from my hand today! It had a tiny tongue. I'm not washing my hand.
I made a friend at the fence today. It's wild, so I can't keep it, but I can visit.
We played chase all afternoon, me and a wild one. It won. I think it always wins.

cheerful.li: I have a secret friend and it's a Pokémon and it's the best secret ever.

gloomy.li: My friend at the fence didn't come today. Maybe tomorrow.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} came to sit with me today for no reason at all. Those are the best days.
I sat down after work and {X_nameDef} was there before I'd got comfortable. It always knows.
[night] Quiet evening with my Pokémon. Neither of us said anything. Neither of us needed to.

warm.li: Whatever else goes wrong here, {X_nameDef} is glad to see me. Every single day.

blunt.li: Good day. Spent the end of it with my Pokémon.

cheerful.li: {X_nameDef} climbed into my lap again. It's far too big. I love it.

gloomy.li: On the bad days it's my Pokémon that keeps me going. I don't say that out loud.

cold.li: Time with my Pokémon today. It keeps it calm, and me.

plain.li: [opt0] Half the colony lay in the grass on the ridge to watch the rare one. Nobody said a word. I'll remember the quiet as much as the animal.
[opt1] I followed the rare one for two days to learn its ways. I know where it drinks and where it sleeps. Whether I can catch it is another matter.
[opt1] Out after the rare one since dawn. It let me get close once. Only once.
[opt2] We let the rare one go by. It was the right thing, probably. I keep looking at the ridge anyway.

warm.li: [opt0] We all went to see it together. That's the bit I'll keep: all of us in the grass, holding our breath.

blunt.li: [opt2] Let the rare one pass. Plenty to do here.

cheerful.li: [opt1] I'm on the trail of a rare one! Me! Wish me luck, journal.

gloomy.li: [opt2] The rare one went over the ridge and that was that. We'll never see one again.

cold.li: [opt1] Tracked the rare one. Its habits are noted, for next time.
